name: RoadGuard AI Unified 4-Class Road Hazard Dataset
description: Standardized multi-country road hazard dataset for edge YOLO object detection. Re-annotated from RDD2022 (Japan, India, Czech) preserving the authoritative 4-class damage taxonomy.

sources.name: Road Damage Dataset 2022 (RDD2022)
sources.citation: Arya, D., Maeda, H., Ghosh, S. K., Toshniwal, D., Mraz, A., Kashiyama, T., & Sekimoto, Y. (2022). Crowdsensing-based Road Damage Detection: Challenge and Datasets. IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems.
sources.raw_format: Pascal VOC XML (32-bit integer pixel coordinates)

target_classes.name: D00_longitudinal_crack
target_classes.description: Longitudinal crack parallel to the road centerline.

target_classes.name: D10_transverse_crack
target_classes.description: Transverse crack perpendicular to the road centerline.

target_classes.name: D20_alligator_crack
target_classes.description: Alligator or crocodile pattern fatigue cracking in asphalt.

target_classes.name: D40_pothole
target_classes.description: Structural bowl-shaped cavity or depression in road surface.

train.strategy: Geographic group split (Japan sub-prefectures + India urban sectors)

val.strategy: Disjoint geographic evaluation regions (Czech test corridors + separate Japan prefectures)

test.strategy: Independent hold-out test set with zero geographic overlap
